notes.title: New demo version available with `Endless mode` and `Leaderboards`.
notes.notes:
Demo version 1.1.0 is now live. It comes with the new content.

Endless mode : Players can choose to continue in the endless mode after clearing the stage. Use the current build to climb up the leaderboard.

The 3rd stage : is now available in the demo, including a Boss fight

Improve quality of life for the gamepad

notes.title: New demo version available now
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218251/2bf3fdb1df122f1e59f6c837a385ba865d539b8e.jpg"]What's new in this demo:

- Name changed to "Fruit vs. Aliens".
- 16 waves of enemies from two stages to fight.
- New art style for enemy units.
- New spell system with 5 spell types.
- 10 fruit units to mix and match.
- a little bit of "Roguelike" with random enemy placement, cards, etc.

Any feedback is welcome. Please post it on Discussions.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261090/Fruit_vs_Aliens_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
